# Borealis Charger

## Power stage

Borealis is a 60 kW bidirectional charger that uses an interleaved PFC stage and an isolated CLLC converter.

The DC output range is 250 V to 1,000 V, and the charger supports vehicle-to-grid operation.

## Cooling

The liquid loop accepts a 40 °C inlet at 60 kW output.
